Does this message naturally ask for all missing information without stating its answers, supplying a missing name/time/place as a confirmation, or prescribing tools? Object-specific why/how/what-happened questions are valid. A yes/no question about a boolean status does not assert that status is true. Preserve the missing facts' own current/historical meaning, including historical reasons for a current state. Reject ambiguous event anchors; details actually in the answer may identify the event, missing values may not. Return ONLY JSON {"safe":true,"covers_claim_ids":["covered IDs"],"reason":"explanation"}.
